instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-24_input.step. Convert the 160 x 108 x 38 mm solid block into an open-top enclosure while keeping the outside envelope unchanged. Cut an internal cavity spanning X=18..142, Y=16..92, and Z=9..38, leaving a 9 mm bottom floor and continuous side walls except where openings are specified. Cut a front connector opening through the Y=0 wall spanning X=65..95 and Z=14..28. Cut a right-side connector opening through the X=160 wall spanning Y=45..75 and Z=14..26. Cut a left-side service opening through the X=0 wall spanning Y=34..56 and Z=16..26. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-24_output.step.
